text: No, there is no tree-cover loss candidate on this property after 2020. The latest tree-cover loss event observed was in 2025, which occurred outside the period of interest (after 2020). While tree-cover loss was detected in 2025 (13.5 ha, 3.91% of the asset), it does not meet the analyst's criteria of occurring *after* 2020. The asset had 65.71% forest cover in 2020 (JRC data) and 128 ha of tree cover in 2000 (Hansen data), but no loss events were recorded between 2020 and 2025.
